479     *
480     * @return array
481     */
482    public function getMiddlewareGroups()
483    {
484        $middleware = [
485            'web' => array_values(array_filter([
486                \Illuminate\Cookie\Middleware\EncryptCookies::class,
487                \Illuminate\Cookie\Middleware\AddQueuedCookiesToResponse::class,
488                \Illuminate\Session\Middleware\StartSession::class,
489                \Illuminate\View\Middleware\ShareErrorsFromSession::class,
490                \Illuminate\Foundation\Http\Middleware\ValidateCsrfToken::class,
491                \Illuminate\Routing\Middleware\SubstituteBindings::class,
492                $this->authenticatedSessions ? 'auth.session' : null,
493            ])),
494
495            'api' => array_values(array_filter([
496                $this->statefulApi ? \Laravel\Sanctum\Http\Middleware\EnsureFrontendRequestsAreStateful::class : null,
497                $this->apiLimiter ? 'throttle:'.$this->apiLimiter : null,
498                \Illuminate\Routing\Middleware\SubstituteBindings::class,
499            ])),
500        ];
501
502        $middleware = array_merge($middleware, $this->groups);
503
504        foreach ($middleware as $group => $groupedMiddleware) {
505            foreach ($groupedMiddleware as $index => $groupMiddleware) {
506                if (isset($this->groupReplacements[$group][$groupMiddleware])) {
507                    $middleware[$group][$index] = $this->groupReplacements[$group][$groupMiddleware];
508                }
509            }
510        }
511
512        foreach ($this->groupRemovals as $group => $removals) {
513            $middleware[$group] = array_values(array_filter(
514                array_diff($middleware[$group] ?? [], $removals)
515            ));
516        }
517
518        foreach ($this->groupPrepends as $group => $prepends) {
519            $middleware[$group] = array_values(array_filter(
520                array_unique(array_merge($prepends, $middleware[$group] ?? []))
521            ));
522        }
523
524        foreach ($this->groupAppends as $group => $appends) {
525            $middleware[$group] = array_values(array_filter(
526                array_unique(array_merge($middleware[$group] ?? [], $appends))
527            ));
528        }
529
530        return $middleware;
531    }
